s: A company is planning a one-time migration of an on-premises MySQL database to Amazon Aurora MySQL in the us-east-1 Region. The company's current internet connection has limited bandwidth. The on-premises MySQL database is 60 TB in size The company estimates that it will take a month to transfer the data to AWS over the current internet connection. The company needs a migration solution that will migrate the database more quickly Which solution will migrate the database in the LEAST amount of time?
o: Request a 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises data center and AWS Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the on-premises MySQL database to Aurora MySQL.

Use AWS DataSync with the current internet connection to accelerate the data transfer between the onpremises data center and AWS Use AWS Application Migration Service to migrate the on-premises MySQL database to Aurora MySQL.
Order an AWS Snowball Edge Device Load the data into an Amazon S3 bucket by using the S3 interface Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the data from Amazon S3 to Aurora MySQL
Order an AWS Snowball Device Load the data into an Amazon S3 bucket by using the S3 Adapter for Snowball Use AWS Application Migration Service to migrate the data from Amazon S3 to Aurora MySQL.
e: For migrating 60 TB of MySQL data in the least amount of time: l AWS Snowball (physical data transfer): Given the limited internet bandwidth and 1-month estimated transfer time, AWS Snowball is significantly faster. Snowball can transfer the initial 60 TB in days rather than weeks. Data is loaded onto a Snowball appliance, physically shipped to AWS, and imported into the target system. l AWS Database Migration Service (DMS): Use DMS for the continuous replication phase after Snowball completes the initial transfer. DMS handles schema conversion, full load, and change data capture (CDC) for ongoing replication until cutover. l Combined approach benefits: Snowball handles the bulk transfer quickly (not constrained by limited bandwidth), while DMS manages the database-specific aspects and incremental changes l Why pure DMS over internet is slow: DMS alone over limited bandwidth would take the estimated month. Snowball accelerates the initial load. This combination minimizes total migration time by using the most appropriate tool for each phase.

w.y: 'LEAST amount of time' for 60 TB over a slow link points to shipping the data on a Snowball Edge device. Once in S3, DMS can use S3 as a source and load Aurora MySQL.

o.A: A new Direct Connect connection usually takes weeks to provision, so the total time is longer.
o.B: DataSync cannot speed up a limited internet link, and MGN migrates servers, not databases into Aurora.
o.C: Correct: Snowball Edge to S3, then DMS from S3 into Aurora MySQL.
o.D: Application Migration Service does not load data from S3 into Aurora.

st: Right for the exam; Snowball Edge is now available only to existing customers, and AWS points new projects to DataSync, Data Transfer Terminal or partner devices.
